objects.triage_summary: First-principles derivation of the exact 9-pin conditional Gaussian law and of the theorems W2-1 to W2-17. These include the corrected global CS (W2-7), the slice factorizations, explicit Chernoff/Hanson-Wright tails and the box lower bound (W2-17), with a validity ledger of proven-valid and proven-invalid forms. The fail-closed sanity script backs it with 113 checks.
